answer: A sybil farm is an orchard of hollow keys that mostly vouch for each other. Make the reward graph a trellis instead: a new key's attestations only count when they come from graders randomly drawn from at least three unrelated established clusters, and each epoch the system measures how many edges a cluster has to the outside. A clique with many members but almost no outside attestations is capped at one key's payout, so spawning more identities earns nothing extra.
